summary: I set the dashboard's auto-refresh to '1m' and saved twice, confirming persistence. In dashboard settings (gear/settings button) > General, the time-options 'Auto refresh' control is not a dropdown in this Grafana build but a text field holding the interval list (it read "5s,10s,30s,1m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,1d"); I set it to '1m' and clicked the top-bar 'Save dashboard' (the drawer showed no 'Update default time range' checkbox because the 6h time range was unchanged, so nothing needed ticking), then clicked Save and the drawer closed. I then selected '1m' in the top bar's auto-refresh interval dropdown (the menu now offered only 1m) and saved again, this time the drawer offered the analogous checkbox 'Update default refresh value / Will make the current refresh the new default', which I TICKED (it enabled the Save button) before clicking Save. Verification after a full page reload: re-opening settings > General shows the Auto refresh value reads exactly '1m' (and the URL carries refresh=1m), the top bar shows the refresh interval as 1m with the time range still 'Last 6 hours', and the Versions tab lists a new latest entry Version 5 dated 2026-09-26 07:45:30 by admin, confirming the save. So: Auto refresh value seen = '1m'; the 'Update default time range' checkbox did not appear (no time-range change), but the equivalent 'Update default refresh value' checkbox was present and was ticked before saving.
